description:
Project Overview

The Schlumberger Foundation's Faculty for the Future programme awards fellowships to women from developing and emerging economies to pursue PhD or postdoctoral research in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) at leading universities abroad.

The 2027–2028 fellowship round is open for new applications from 1 September 2026 to 7 November 2026. Since its launch in 2004, the programme has funded over 800 women from 86 countries.

Research position overview

Fellowships provide up to USD 50,000 per year for PhD or postdoctoral research. Applicants must already have applied to, been admitted to, or be enrolled at an overseas host institution. The programme encourages women who will return to their home countries to contribute to STEM education and research.

Research Areas

  • Engineering and technology
  • Physical sciences and mathematics
  • Biological and life sciences
  • Computer science and data science
  • Environmental and earth sciences
